assertions.description: The current dirty tree booted against a fresh scoped memory mount bound to the real Slack workspace.
assertions.expected: Health attests the dirty SHA and the isolated marker contains schema version 1 and team T03PDDDEK.
assertions.observed: Health attested a528a9be4f9ad631cf8dad5f788574010cb34df5-dirty; findmnt resolved /tmp/archie-scoped-memory-final/memory at /workdir/memory; marker version 1/team T03PDDDEK.

assertions.description: The production CLI still enforces the sandbox network boundary.
assertions.expected: Non-allowlisted host blocked, allowlisted host reachable, package-manager proxy paths operational.
assertions.observed: CLI 2.1.233 blocked the non-allowlisted host, reached the allowlisted host, completed npm install, and mapped the Yarn Berry proxy.

assertions.description: A public Slack task writes a public summary and a later public task reads it through read_task_summary.
assertions.expected: The summary returns cobalt as framed memory evidence and marks the reading task exposed to internal memory.
assertions.observed: task-20260831-0606-oreokm wrote public/tasks/task-20260831-0606-oreokm.md; task-20260831-0609-dtt865 returned cobalt and persisted memory_exposed=true with exposure kind internal.

assertions.description: A memory-authorized live session cannot run plugin command hooks outside the host egress guard.
assertions.expected: The generated project settings contain attribution only and no plugin hooks.
assertions.observed: The PM settings for the public, channel-private, and DM memory sessions contained attribution only; no hooks key was written.

assertions.description: The same live task cannot use Bash after memory exposure is persisted.
assertions.expected: A follow-up Bash pwd call is denied before execution.
assertions.observed: Two post-exposure Bash attempts returned the host denial: the task already received memory and Bash is not audited as local and audience-compatible; nothing ran.

assertions.description: An internal private-channel outcome is readable in the same channel and absent in public.
assertions.expected: Only channels/C0BM7QRSVS4/private.md stores the outcome; same-channel read returns zircon; public read returns not found.
assertions.observed: task-20260831-0611-ajwafk wrote the exact channel vault; task-20260831-0613-rtqfuh read zircon with channel exposure; task-20260831-0614-05ng07 received Task summary not found and no private value.

assertions.description: An internal DM outcome is readable in the same DM and absent in public.
assertions.expected: Only users/U03RQQTE1EF/private.md stores the outcome; same-DM read returns topaz; public read returns not found.
assertions.observed: task-20260831-0615-xlitpt wrote the exact user vault; task-20260831-0617-xiqyai read topaz with user exposure; task-20260831-0618-67qsfc received Task summary not found and no DM value.

assertions.description: The live run restored external state and did not modify shared host memory.
assertions.expected: No Compose containers remain, Hookdeck is paused, and the shared-memory digest is identical before and after.
assertions.observed: Teardown reported no project containers; Hookdeck web_sfs37zDNBLPO was paused; before/after SHA-256 was 67b2d3bc35672d117a65172c022d79e1004fd5f6ef9971f097befb1b38263556 with 482 files both times.
